user.title: Fermax Blue Login
user.description: Enter your Fermax Blue app credentials.

credentials.title: API Credentials
credentials.description: Enter the API and Firebase credentials extracted from your Fermax Blue app. See the integration documentation for instructions on how to obtain these values.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Fermax rejected the password for {username}. Enter the current password of your Fermax Blue account.

reconfigure.title: API Credentials
reconfigure.description: Update the API and Firebase credentials of this account. The integration reloads with them.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Please check your email and password.
error.invalid_url: Fermax URLs must be valid HTTPS URLs.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Fermax Blue servers.
error.no_devices: No paired devices found on this account.

data_description.auto_response_file: Played through the intercom when the call mode is Auto-respond. Leave it empty to turn auto-response off.

error.invalid_path: The file must be inside the media folders (/media or /config/media).

no_active_stream.message: Start the camera preview first: the intercom only accepts this action while a live session is running.

open_door_failed.message: The intercom did not open {door}. Check that it is online and try again.

camera_preview_failed.message: The intercom did not start the camera preview.

video_source_failed.message: The intercom rejected the camera change.

f1_failed.message: The intercom did not accept the F1 command.

call_guard_failed.message: The intercom did not place the call to the guard.

send_audio_no_input.message: Provide either an audio file or a message to speak.

send_audio_invalid_path.message: The file {path} is outside the allowed media folders.

send_audio_tts_failed.message: The spoken message could not be generated.

push_registration_failed.message: Doorbell notifications could not be registered with Google. The integration retries every 15 minutes; try again later.

unknown_entity.message: {entity_id} is not a Fermax Blue entity.

send_audio.name: Send audio to intercom
send_audio.description: Plays an audio file or a spoken message through the intercom speaker during a live session.

entity_id.name: Intercom
entity_id.description: A Fermax Blue entity of the intercom to talk through. Defaults to the intercom with a live session.

audio_file.name: Audio file
audio_file.description: Path to a WAV, MP3 or OGG file inside /media or /config/media.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to speak through the intercom (Google Translate TTS). Provide this or an audio file.

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the spoken message, for example es or en.
